conditional_on: correctness of the full unchanged frozen Theorem A and Corollary B relative to the stipulated pin; correctness is not assessed here

scope_assessed.theorem_A: for every fixed integer k>=1 and real delta>0, deterministic poly-time 3SAT -> nonempty simple graph; SAT => G->C_{2k+1}; UNSAT => alpha(G)<delta|V(G)|; constants/degree depend on (k,delta)
scope_assessed.corollary_B: for all finite loopless H,G with H non-bipartite and H->G: PCSP(H,G) NP-hard; search NP-hard under poly-time Turing reductions; density form for every non-bipartite H and delta>0

reasons: Source 106 operative soundness consumes the threshold only through an explicit interface (lists.tex 33-40) and the symbol L; thm:junta and lem:influences hold for every finite L, and all constants are chosen after L (parameters.tex 10-37).
The nominee substitutes threshold 1/8 -> 1/(4k+2), bump slope 32 -> 4k+2, L 64 -> 8k+4; every interface check is a one-line instantiation; no new lemma, estimate or construction.
Completeness by 2k+1 arcs is the folklore discretisation chi_c<=2+1/k iff G->C_{2k+1} (KOWZ 2003.11351v3, text 307-333) applied to source 106's own phase map.
Corollary B is the standard sandwich (KOWZ text 286-296) plus the fibre count already used in source 106 cor:coloring.
No nonroutine compatibility issue was found (clique branch, separation, bump radius, Lipschitz constant, parameter order, encoding, delta range).
Project acceptance rule excludes routine transfers (NEW-TEN-2026-10-14.md line 17); the major named consequence follows technically from the stipulated source method.
significance_note: High: under the pin the nominee yields the full Brakensiek-Guruswami conjecture (KOWZ Conjecture 1.2), which arXiv 2605.09815v2 (18 Oct 2026) still described as known only under the Rich 2-to-1 Conjecture. That paper does not cite source 106.
